title: Private apartment in heart of East Nashville!
description:
Spacious newly remodeled private apartment with no-contact check-in & keypad entry! Minutes from tons of hip restaurants, bars, & shops, along with a brand new Publix just 4 blocks away. Only a mile to Five Points, 3 miles to Lower Broadway, & easy access to all highways. No full kitchen, but there’s a mini-fridge & microwave if you need to heat your Nashville Hot Chicken leftovers. If you’re looking for a simple, safe, clean, & convenient spot this is your place. Can't wait for your visit!

The space
The airbnb has one queen bed, two futons, and an air mattress. There is no full kitchen, but there is a microwave and mini-refrigerator. It's a simple space, but it's very spacious!

The neighborhood is a quiet and safe residential area, with plenty of available street parking.

The Airbnb is at the front of our house and we live in the back portion. It's completely private with its own entrance and no shared spaces, but be aware that we live on the property.
